citation: Landry, S. H., Zucker, T. A., Williams, J. M., Merz, E. C., Guttentag, C. L., & Taylor, H. B. (2017). Improving school readiness of high-risk preschoolers: Combining high quality instructional strategies with responsive training for teachers and parents. Early Childhood Research Quarterly, 40, 38-51. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecresq.2016.12.001
report_number: Early Childhood Research Quarterly, Vol. 40, pp. 38-51 (IES award R305A100212)
design: RCT, 2x2 fully-crossed factorial. Factor 1 = teacher professional development (TEEM, The Early Education Model) randomized at the Teacher/Classroom level (TEEM n=39 classrooms vs No-TEEM business-as-usual n=38; 77 classrooms total in analyses). Factor 2 = parent program (PALS, Play and Learning Strategies) randomized at the child/family level within classroom (PALS n=314 vs No PALS n=309; ~6-8 children/classroom). 623 parent-child dyads enrolled; 434 children completed (30% attrition). Setting: Head Start, Houston & Austin, 3 academic years; children ages ~3-5 (mean 4.37y, Pre-k), low-SES (96% free lunch), ~66% Latino/Hispanic. Subject: early language & literacy school readiness (no child math/STEM outcome was measured). Child outcomes analyzed by multilevel ANCOVA on posttest controlling for pretest, home language, and child age, with classroom nesting accounted for.
problems: FACTORIAL DESIGN: This is a 2x2 crossed RCT (TEEM teacher-PD x PALS parent-program), giving four cells: TEEM/PALS, TEEM/No-PALS, No-TEEM/PALS, No-TEEM/No-PALS. The meta-analysis needs the TPD-vs-no-TPD (teacher-training) contrast, so I extracted the MAIN EFFECT of TEEM (TEEM vs No-TEEM), which pools across PALS status: the 'TEEM classroom' cells (TEEM/PALS + TEEM/No-PALS, n=102+112=214 children) vs the 'No-TEEM classroom' cells (PALS/No-TEEM + No-TEEM/No-PALS, n=109+111=220 children). These are the 'TEEM vs. no TEEM' rows of Table 5 (p.47). The model first tested the TEEMxPALS interaction; if non-significant it was dropped and main effects tested simultaneously. CAVEATS: (1) The paper reports Cohen's d rounded to TWO decimals only (no exact b/SE/means-SDs in the article body; descriptive M/SD are in online Supplement Table A8 which is NOT in this PDF), so g is computed by applying the small-sample correction J to the rounded d -> g is approximate and g_var is computed from n's (Var(d)=(nt+nc)/(nt*nc)+d^2/(2N)), NOT from a reported model SE. (2) Phonological Awareness has a SIGNIFICANT TEEMxPALS interaction (d=-0.33, p<.05: TEEM-without-PALS children gained most), so its TEEM main effect (d=0.10) is qualified/uninterpretable in isolation; recorded but flagged. (3) NO child math/STEM achievement outcome exists: the only achievement outcomes are language/literacy. The '27-item mathematics tasks' and 'Math (5 items)' in the paper are teacher progress-monitoring / TBRS teacher-behavior measures (Table 2), not child outcomes. (4) Skipped per spec: teacher outcomes (TBRS, Table 2), parent outcomes (Tables 3-4), and child SOCIAL/BEHAVIORAL & SELF-REGULATION outcomes (Effortful Control, Social Competence, School Liking/Avoidance, gift-delay & bear/dragon tasks in Table 5) -- none are academic achievement. (5) n_clusters per arm not separately reported for the child analytic sample; total analyzed classrooms = 77 (TEEM 39 / No-TEEM 38); ICC not reported for child achievement outcomes (only for teacher TBRS and self-regulation task reliability) -- left null per 'never guess an ICC'. Distinct study from Landry 2014 (row 64) and Landry 2021 (row 66). Identity matches meta-analysis supplement: Teacher/Class RCT, Pre-k, Comprehensive approaches.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TEEM teacher-PD (vs No-TEEM business-as-usual); main effect pooled over PALS
effect_sizes.test_name: TOPEL Print Knowledge subtest (Test of Preschool Early Literacy; 36 items: letter recognition, book & print concepts)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d with J=0.9983 (df=n_t+n_c-2=432). d=0.10 is the paper's reported Cohen's d for the TEEM-vs-no-TEEM main effect (Table 5, p.47), standardized by the pooled posttest SD within the multilevel ANCOVA framework. b=1.08 is the raw model coefficient. g_var computed as J^2*[(n_t+n_c)/(n_t*n_c)+d^2/(2(n_t+n_c))] since no model SE is reported; g_se=sqrt(g_var).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.47, Table 5 (Cognitive skills -> Print Knowledge -> 'TEEM vs. no TEEM' row); narrative p.47 sec 3.5.2
effect_sizes.notes: TOPEL Print Knowledge subtest = early literacy/print-letter knowledge -> Reading. TEEM main effect non-significant (only the PALS main effect d=0.14 was significant for this outcome). d reported to 2 decimals only; g approximate. cluster_adjusted=true because child analyses used multilevel ANCOVA accounting for classroom nesting (Raudenbush & Bryk 2002). One of three TOPEL subtests; no TOPEL total reported.

effect_sizes.test_name: TOPEL Phonological Awareness subtest (Test of Preschool Early Literacy; 27 items: elision & blending tasks)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d with J=0.9983 (df=432). d=0.10 is the paper's reported Cohen's d for the TEEM-vs-no-TEEM main effect (Table 5, p.47), standardized by pooled posttest SD in the multilevel ANCOVA. b=0.49 is the raw model coefficient. g_var = J^2*[(n_t+n_c)/(n_t*n_c)+d^2/(2(n_t+n_c))]; g_se=sqrt(g_var).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.47, Table 5 (Cognitive skills -> Phonological Awareness -> 'TEEM vs. no TEEM' row); narrative p.47-48
effect_sizes.notes: TOPEL Phonological Awareness subtest -> Reading (early literacy). IMPORTANT QUALIFIER: there is a SIGNIFICANT TEEMxPALS interaction for this outcome (d=-0.33, p<.05) -- children in TEEM classrooms whose parents did NOT receive PALS gained most -- so the TEEM main effect d=0.10 is qualified and should be treated cautiously by central merge. d reported to 2 decimals only; g approximate.

effect_sizes.page_ref: p.47, Table 5 (Cognitive skills -> Language skills -> 'TEEM vs. no TEEM' row); composite defined in Table 5 note & sec 2.9.3 (p.44)
effect_sizes.notes: 'Language skills' is a composite factor (oral/receptive/expressive language) formed because the language measures were highly correlated (rs=0.62-0.86); composed of EOWPVT-SBE, PLS-4 Auditory Comprehension, PLS-4 Expressive Communication, and TOPEL Definitional Vocabulary. Mapped to Other (language, not reading/literacy). Component subtests are NOT reported separately, only as this composite. TEEM main effect non-significant and very small (d=0.05). d reported to 2 decimals only; g approximate.
